name: NDW BL Router · ESP32-C3
description: Relays frames from nearby sensors to the network over WiFi.
$comment: chipMatch is tested against what esptool-js reports after connecting, e.g. 'ESP32-C3 (revision v0.4)'. One build targets one chip: the bootloader offset below differs per family, and a mismatched image leaves the board unbootable until it is reflashed.
$comment2: ota-data-initial.bin is 8KB of 0xff — the erased state that tells the bootloader no OTA slot has been selected, so boot ota_0. It is only needed because the console flashes with eraseAll false: a board carrying stale otadata from earlier firmware would otherwise boot a slot that no longer holds a valid image.
